name: Korean
notes: The Korean minor takes effect in fall 2026. Five four-credit courses.

TRANSFER: one language course or one Korean/East Asian culture-and-history course may be transferred from another institution or a semester abroad; language transfer requires passing the Korean placement test.
One summer study-abroad program (KORE 107, KORE 157 or KORE 207) may replace one language course or one culture/history course.
MLC also awards a Korean Language Distinction Certificate for six or more language courses with a GPA of at least 3.3; students doing the language-only track of the minor are eligible.

requirementGroups.label: Four consecutive Korean language courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The minor in Korean requires five four-credit courses. Students have the choice of the following two options: Option one: Take five consecutive language courses from the list of Korean language courses. Option two: Take a minimum of four consecutive Korean language courses from the list of Korean language courses, plus a minimum of one course in Korean/East Asian culture and history offered by the Department of Modern Languages and Cultures or the Program of East Asian Studies.
requirementGroups.note: Both options share these four; the language courses must be consecutive, which the planner cannot check.

requirementGroups.label: Fifth course: a further language course or an East Asian culture/history course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Option one: Take five consecutive language courses ... Option two: ... plus a minimum of one course in Korean/East Asian culture and history offered by the Department of Modern Languages and Cultures or the Program of East Asian Studies.
requirementGroups.note: Option two's culture/history course may also come from the East Asian Studies program outside MLC; consult the Korean program faculty when choosing it.
